verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a stablecoin checkout. Customers can pay in USDC or USDT from any wallet or their Coinbase account, through a two-step auth-and-capture flow with partial captures and voids. A Checkouts API exposes settlement details, deposit-destination addresses auto-credit a custodial account, and real-time webhooks plus a sandbox support programmatic confirmation and testing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the checkout flow, and explicit documentation tying specific webhook event types to payment settlement confirmation (no public OpenAPI spec was found by probe).
